scientific_integrity: Proof uses explicit characteristic polynomials and interlacing. Reproducibility checker gives 2577 corroborating assertions and is not a substitute for a proof. Independently checked human validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact symmetric four-patch landscape Perron-eigenvalue comparison, with strictly positive fixed path weights, one of two bidirectional added corridors, proportional effort. No claim about general patch persistence probabilities, empirical optimum, heterogeneous extinction rates, or more than two alternative edges. Historical priority not independently certified; key foundational technical article not read in full.
title: A unique corridor-investment reversal in a four-patch landscape
